content_sections.heading: NIT Andhra Pradesh Office Associate Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIT Andhra Pradesh Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NIT Andhra Pradesh Office Associate Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Office Associate : First Class Bachelor's Degree from a recognized institute, Type Writing English Lower (35WPM). Experience of working in Academic offices and Proficiency in MS Office is desirable.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: No age limit details are specified in the official notification. Candidates are advised to refer to the official PDF for any clarifications regarding age requirements.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Office Associate : Rs.18,000/- to Rs.21,000/- (Skilled/Highly Skilled Category)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Andhra Pradesh Office Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Andhra Pradesh (NIT Andhra Pradesh) for filling up temporary vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The post offered in this recruitment drive is Office Associate under a third-party outsourcing contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Office Associate position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Office Associate position at NIT Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NIT Andhra Pradesh Office Associate Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to directly attend the walk-in interaction at the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interaction and reporting are scheduled to take place on 08 October 2026. Candidates must check reporting times carefully.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Bachelor's Degree from a recognized institute along with Type Writing English Lower (35WPM) proficiency.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to attend the interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview for these positions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for the Office Associate position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates under the skilled/highly skilled category will receive a consolidated salary ranging between Rs. 18,000/- to Rs. 21,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Institute of Technology Andhra Pradesh located?
faq.answer: The institute is located in Tadepalligudem, in the state of Andhra Pradesh, with the pincode 534101.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form along with all original educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and self-attested photocopies.
